source_caption_text:
Kim really dressed up like North for Halloween 😂👻🎃

Via: @kimkardashian 

Kim Kardashian took Halloween inspiration from her own daughter, recreating North West’s blue-haired look 😭💙 From the long, bright blue hair to the oversized black graphic tee and statement skull chain, Kim’s costume was all about matching North’s style.

The original look even featured black nails and tiny metallic details across North’s hand, giving Kim plenty of details to work with. With such a recognizable outfit, she didn’t have to look far for a costume idea 😂🔥

Usually kids dress up like their famous parents, but Kim flipped it and made her daughter the inspiration this time. Imagine putting together an outfit and then seeing your mom recreate it for Halloween 😭

How’d she do with the recreation? 👀
